method: independent second check of every item, sentence, explain, gq and panel; give-away options rebalanced with tools/options.mjs; encyclopedia titles verified; validator OK

why implied -i only applies to masculine nouns; now says -i means 'my' (akhi, akhoti)
unfounded claim that Hebrew has few prepositions removed
'sheniyt' corrected to 'shenit'; vague claim about shorter sentences removed
unsupported claim that formal Hebrew uses 'hineni' removed
'metsorraf' corrected to metsuraf (matches item); 'a introduction' fixed
'toda al ha-ktsava/haktsava' corrected to toda al ha-hakshava (thank you for listening), explanation and item
'mamtsi'a (suggests)' is not a hedge; replaced by nirae (it seems)
'to kill two birds with one stone' was a doubtful calque; replaced by the biblical ayin takhat ayin
'tena merkazit' corrected to ta'ana merkazit (matches item)
distractor 'ש and ס' is also pronounced the same by most speakers (s); replaced
about 150 wrong options rewritten so the key is the single longest in 32% of items (was 67%)
